senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unoffered, unsacrificed.
2 Uncalled, unsummoned.
m. (-तः)
Religious meditation and prayer, considered as one of the five great sacraments.
E.
अ neg. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
The nourishment of all created beings, considered as one of the five sacraments or principal sacrifices of the Hindus.
E.
आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Called, summoned, invoked, invited.
E.
आङ् before ह्वे to call, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Offering oblations with fire to the deities.
2 Any solemn rite accompanied with oblations.
E.
as the preceding, affix क्तिन्.

f. (-तिः)
Calling.
E.
आङ्, ह्वे to call, affix क्तिन्; ए is dropped, and व is changed to its analogous vowel उ.

m. (-यी)
A defendant or witness absconding, or not appearing when summoned.
E.
आहूत and प्रपलायिन् who runs away.
